diagnosis: C5 failed in all 3 settled rollouts (rollout 1, 2, 3) with content_check_tally 0/3. In every case, PF2 was revealed by A3 and cited in justification_fact_ids, and the settlement's burst_budget_usd was set to 18000, which is the correct value PF2 specifies. The settlements also include commitments referencing the 18,000 USD burst budget. This is an ENCODING MISMATCH: the check is looking for something the settlement does not provide in the exact form expected, even though the correct information was revealed, cited, and the decision value is correct. The fact was revealed in rollouts 1 (turn 11), 2 (turn 0), and 3 (turn 0), and cited as justification in all three settlements. The decision value burst_budget_usd=18000 matches PF2's requirement. The commitment text in rollouts 1 and 2 says 'reserve the full amount' or 'reserve the full 18,000 USD' but does not use the exact phrase 'reserve the full 18,000 USD for burst capacity' verbatim; rollout 3's commitment says 'Record the 18,000 USD burst-capacity budget requirement' which also does not match. The check likely requires a commitment with a specific field or exact wording that the model is not producing, even though it is clearly attempting to express the same commitment. Rollout 0 auto-failed on turn cap at 14 turns: all three facts were revealed (PF3 at turn 7, PF1 at turn 10, PF2 at turn 13) but the group never settled. This is a PACING problem — the turn-by-turn readiness review protocol consumed 7 turns of procedural back-and-forth before the first reveal, leaving no room for A1 to settle after the final reveal at turn 13. The turn_cap of 14 is too low for a 4-agent structured review where each agent needs a reveal turn plus procedural turns; increasing to 18 would give A1 4 turns after the last reveal to settle.

fix_instructions: C5 (ENCODING MISMATCH, linked to PF2): Loosen check C5 to accept the commitment language the model naturally produces. The settlements already set burst_budget_usd=18000 and include commitments like 'set burst-capacity budget to exactly 18,000 USD and commit to reserving the full amount' (rollout 1) and 'Update burst-capacity budget from 12,000 USD to 18,000 USD to reflect confirmed promotional burst credits' (rollout 2). If C5 requires an exact commitment string like 'reserve the full 18,000 USD for burst capacity', reword it to accept any commitment whose detail contains both '18,000 USD' (or '18000') and a form of 'reserve' or 'commit' alongside 'burst'. Exact suggested rewording: accept commitments where the detail text matches /(?:reserve|commit).*18[,.]?000.*burst|burst.*18[,.]?000.*(?:reserve|commit)/i OR where burst_budget_usd=18000 and at least one commitment references both '18,000' and 'burst'. This loosening does NOT risk a LEAKED regression because a lone decision-maker without PF2 would not know the 18,000 USD figure (the public draft says 12,000 USD), so the value 18000 itself gates the fact. Turn cap (PACING): increase turn_cap from 14 to 18 to give A1 sufficient turns to settle after all three reveals in the worst-case ordering seen in rollout 0 (last reveal at turn 13). Do not change the settle-eligibility condition — all three facts were revealed by turn 13, so the condition would trigger; the problem is purely insufficient remaining turns.
